claims.reason: Long bond maturities reduce immediate forced-selling exposure and average Bitcoin cost basis is not a margin trigger. However, the blanket claim omits collateralized Coinbase trade credits documented during 2021, with a minimum balance requirement effective November. No year-end credits were outstanding; this is a qualification of immunity, not evidence that a particular November price fall actually triggered liquidation.

evidence.finding: Convertible debt had 2025/2027 maturities; secured notes 2028, with springing maturity terms. Coinbase short-term trade credits separately required collateral, including a $75m minimum balance effective November 2021; none outstanding at year-end.

framework_lessons: Separate the liability structure from asset volatility.
assessment: The timed inflation and growth calls fare well. The gold-bottom claim fails. Crypto and equity valuation convictions require more precise endpoints; neither later price strength nor a long list of risks proves the underlying mechanisms.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
